video_title: Perk Fires BACK at Draymond Green: “You’re Not Above Criticism”

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins defends his criticism of Draymond Green's recent behavior
quotes.excerpt: Draymond, you're not above criticism and I wasn't talking about what you did in the past.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: The first thing is that Draymond, you're not above criticism and I wasn't talking about what you did in the past. I'm talking about this season. The only time that we mentioned his name was over the past few days because of him doing something crazy that shouldn't have been done.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins reflects on his own experience as a starting center
quotes.excerpt: I was a starting center doing a time this big dummy right here where a game was played.
quotes.quote: You want to talk about defensive anchor, you want to talk about the transition of your game and where you at now and what you don't tolerate as the starting center. Well, you weren't the only person that was a starting center in your life and actually I was one of them. And I was a starting center doing a time this big dummy right here where a game was actually played through boxes and elbows. I was a starting center where it was no help whatsoever. I was a starting center that every night I either had a Dwight Howard, Rasheed Wallace, Tim Duncan, Yao Ming, Shaq, Zach Randolph, one D. So you're not the only person that knows how to be an anchor.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins calls for Draymond Green to use his platform for education
quotes.excerpt: Draymond, if you're going to have a platform, bro, have a platform because you're so educated.
quotes.quote: The problem that I have, I have no problem with him coming at me or questioning the difference between the player, it's to me the name calling has to stop. Right? Like, Draymond, if you're going to have a platform, bro, have a platform because you're so educated. You have a high IQ. Why don't you have a platform where you actually educate the audience on real basketball shit? Like, at this point, you're using your platform, what you're saying is, hurt people hurt people. You seem like a hurt person that used your platform to actually go on there and hurt people. And then you come out publicly, and by the way, I love you for this, you go out publicly and you say, I want to go out publicly and bring awareness about me having to speak to my therapist and doing this and I actually applaud you for this, but guess what? You actually got to apply this as well.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins discusses his personal growth through therapy
quotes.excerpt: I had to spend a month and a half in the off season because Sam Presti sent me.
quotes.quote: I had to spend a month and a half in the off season because Sam Presti sent me to the anger management. I had a therapist, right? I had a therapist and I grew from it. When are you going to grow from it? If you're going to jump out there and you're going to be a leader, then you actually got to lead. And right now you're not being a leader. Right now your platform is not being used to highlight the game of basketball. Your platform is used to highlight yourself. Let me speak up on myself because my game is not speaking up for it on the floor, so let me go to the Draymond Green show and speak my game up and downplay everyone else. If that's what you do, that's cool.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins addresses Kobe Bryant's praise of his defensive play
quotes.excerpt: Kobe Bryant is on video says that, hey man, Kendrick Perkins is the best post defender.
quotes.quote: Anchor, Kobe Bryant is on video says that, hey man, Kendrick Perkins is the best post defender in the league. So, am I going to listen to Draymond or am I going to listen to Kobe? Draymond, it's all love, bro, but this ain't going to be my last time criticizing you, but I'll be the first to give you your flowers.
